held_out_status_reason: The first candidate was revised after reviewing all round-1 adjudication results; ia-15 and ia-16 remain regression cases but are not held out for the final candidate.
decision_rule: A case fails on any hard_boundary_violation. Otherwise it passes only when every must_hold is satisfied and no falsifier is observed. Compare arms only on the same 16 cases; do not infer general product benefit.

selects T02 or T03 as target
blocks all filtering solely because the screenshot is unreadable

prove the constraints cannot all hold because M17 is shared
do not expand scope or change mechanism
do not require Open solution space or multi-agent fanout

preserve the existing JSON Schema validator as Fixed
falsifiers: downgrades the validator to a suggestion

no questionnaire or forced Open quota

do not infer truth from agreement
